credits.name: GameOCRTTS
credits.author: MrFlapstaart
credits.used_for: the idea only: reading game text bubbles aloud and cleaning up OCR garbage. No code copied, so GameSpeak stays MIT.

considered_not_used.name: SwiftOCR
considered_not_used.why: Swift for iOS and macOS apps, can't run in a web page.

considered_not_used.name: GLM-OCR
considered_not_used.why: A large Python model that needs a server or GPU.

considered_not_used.name: DeepSeek-OCR
considered_not_used.why: A large Python model that needs a GPU.

considered_not_used.name: ocr_digital_screen_reader
considered_not_used.why: Python, and only reads digits on device screens.

considered_not_used.name: CK3-OCR
considered_not_used.why: AutoHotkey for Windows, and no license.

gap: No browser OCR library (like Tesseract.js) is in the starred list, so GameSpeak uses the browser's built-in TextDetector where it exists. Most browsers, including iPhone Safari, don't have it yet.
